engine_priority.description: When multiple rules within the same topic_group fire simultaneously, only the rule(s) with the highest antecedent count emit their claim. Rules with fewer antecedents whose conditions are a strict subset of a more specific rule's conditions are suppressed (not emitted). Rules with identical antecedent counts in the same topic_group are all emitted (benign siblings — e.g., multiple claims about the same hand type).
engine_priority.formal_spec: For all (r_i, r_j) where r_i.topic_group == r_j.topic_group AND antecedents(r_i) ⊂ antecedents(r_j) (set subset on feature+attribute+value): suppress r_i.claim. Otherwise emit both.
exempt: Benign identical-antecedent siblings (e.g., 6 Square Hand facet rules with 1 antecedent each) have equal specificity — none suppresses another.

rules.claim: If the fate-line rises from the line of life and from that point is strong, success and riches will be won by personal merit
rules.source_quote: If the fate-line rise from the line of life and from that poit on 18 strong, suecess and riches will be won by personal merit;

rules.claim: When broken and irregular, the career will be uncertain; the ups and downs of success and failure full of light and shadow
rules.source_quote: the ups and downs of success and failure full of light and shadow.

rules.claim: A double or sister fate-line is an excellent sign; it denotes two distinct careers which the subject will follow
rules.source_quote: double or sister fate-line is an excellent sign.

rules.claim: An island in the line of fate is a mark of misfortune, loss, and adversity
rules.source_quote: A cross 18 a sign of trouble and follows the same rules as the square, but an island in the line of fate is a mark of misfortune, loss, and adversity (6, Plate XXI.).

rules.claim: A square on the line of fate protects the subject from loss through money, business, or financial matters
rules.source_quote: A square on the hne of fate protects the subject from loss through money, business, or financial matters.

rules.claim: A cross on the line of fate is a sign of trouble and follows the same rules as the square
rules.source_quote: A cross 18 a sign of trouble and follows the same rules as the square, but an island in the line of fate is a mark of misfortune, loss, and adversity (6, Plate XXI.).

rules.claim: Rising from the line of fate, the line of sun increases the success promised by the line of fate and gives more distinction from whatever date it is marked
rules.source_quote: 107 Rising from the line of fate, it increases the success promised by the line of fate, and gives more distinction from whatever date it is marked—from that time on things will greatly improve.

rules.claim: From the Mount of Luna, the line of sun promises success and distinction, largely dependent upon the fancies and the help of others; it is never a certain sign of success
rules.source_quote: From the Mount of Luna it promises success and distinction, largely dependent upon the fancies and the help of others.

rules.claim: Rising from the line of head, there is no caprice of other people in connection with success; the talents of the subject alone being its factor, but not until the second half of life is reached
rules.source_quote: Rising from the line of head, there is no caprice of other people in con- nection with success, the talents of the subject alone being its factor, but not until the second half of life is reached.

rules.claim: Rising from the line of heart, the line of sun denotes a great taste for art and artistic things, and more distinction and influence in the world at that late date in life
rules.source_quote: Rising from the line of heart it merely denotes a great taste for art and artistic things, and looking at it from the purely practical standpoint it denotes more distinction and influence in the world at that late date in life.

rules.claim: It is an excellent sign to be without the line of health; such absence denotes an extremely robust, healthy constitution
rules.source_quote: It is an excellent sign to be without this line.

rules.claim: When the line of health crosses the hand and touches the line of life at any point, it tells that there is some delicacy at work undermining the health and constitution
rules.source_quote: When crossing the hand and touching the line of life at any point, it tells that there is some delicacy at work, undermining the health and constitution.

rules.claim: If the line of health is very pale in color and broad, it indicates weak action of the heart and bad circulation
rules.source_quote: If very pale in color, and broad, it will be weak action of the heart and bad cireulation.

rules.claim: If red in color, particularly when it leaves the line of heart, the trouble will be active heart-disease
rules.source_quote: If red in color, particularly when it leaves the line of heart, with small, flat nails, the trouble will be active heart-disease.

rules.claim: When the line of health is twisted and irregular, it denotes biliousness and liver complaints
rules.source_quote: When twisted and irregular, bihousness and liver complaints.

rules.claim: When the line of health is formed in little islands, with long, filbert nails, there is danger to lungs and chest
rules.source_quote: In little islands, with long, filbert nails, danger to lungs and chest (?-, Plate XX.).

rules.claim: When the line of health is heavily marked, joining the lines of heart and head, and not found elsewhere, it threatens brain-fever
rules.source_quote: (See “Nails,” Part L, Chapter XIII.) When heavily marked, joining the lines of heart and head, and not found elsewhere, it threatens brain-fever.

rules.claim: When the marriage line is found lying close to the line of heart, the union will be early, about fourteen to twenty-one years of age
rules.source_quote: When the important line is found lying close to the line of heart, the union will be early, about fourteen to twenty-one;

rules.claim: When the marriage line curves or drops downward toward the line of heart, it foretells that the person with whom the subject is married will die first
rules.source_quote: When it curves or drops downward toward the line of heart, it foretells that the person with whom the subject is married will die first (7, Plate X_X.).

rules.claim: When the marriage line curves upward, the possessor is not likely to marry at any time
rules.source_quote: When the line curves upward, the possessor is not likely to marry at any time.

rules.claim: When the marriage line has an island in the center or at any portion, it denotes some very great trouble in married life and a separation while the island lasts
rules.source_quote: When the line has an island in the center or at any portion, it denotes some very great trouble in married life, and a separation while the island | lasts.

rules.claim: When the marriage line breaks in two, it denotes a sudden break in the married life
rules.source_quote: \ When the line breaks in two, it denotes a sudden break in the married life.

rules.claim: When the marriage line divides at the end into a drooping fork sloping toward the center of the hand, it tells of divorce or a judicial separation
rules.source_quote: When the line divides at the end into a drooping fork sloping toward the center of the hand, it tells of divorcee or a judicial separation (17, Plate XIX.).

rules.claim: When the star is on the highest point of the Mount of Jupiter, it promises great honor, power, and position; ambition gratified, and the ultimate success and triumph of the individual
rules.source_quote: When on the highest point of the mount, on the face of the hand, it promises great honor, power, and position;

rules.claim: On the center of the Mount of Saturn, the star is a sign of some terrible fatality; it again gives distinction, but a distinction to be dreaded
rules.source_quote: ~adjacent_page(187) On the center of the Mount of Saturn it is a sign of some terrible fatality (0, Plate XIX.).

rules.claim: The star on the Mount of Luna is a sign of great celebrity arising from the qualities of the mount, namely, through the imaginative faculties
rules.source_quote: The star on the Mount of Luna (1, Plate XVIII.) is, according to my system, a sign of great celebrity arising from the qualities of the mount, namely, through the imaginative faculties.

rules.claim: In the center or highest point of the Mount of Venus, the star on a man's hand indicates extraordinary success in all affairs of love
rules.source_quote: On a man’s hand sucha sign indicates extraordinary success in all affairs of love—the same on a woman’s hand.

rules.claim: When the line of fate runs through a well-formed square, it denotes one of the greatest crises in the subject's life in a worldly sense, but if the line goes right on through the square all danger will be averted
rules.source_quote: When the line of fate runs through a well-formed square, it denotes one of the greatest crises in the subject’s life in a worldly sense, connected with financial disaster or loss, but if the line goes right on throngh the square all danger will be averted.

rules.claim: When the life-line passes through a square, it denotes a protection from death, even if the line be broken at that point
rules.source_quote: When the life-line passes through a square, it denotes a protection from death, even if the line be broken at that point (/, Plate XXL).

rules.claim: When the line of head runs through a well-formed square, it is a sign of strength and preservation to the brain itself, and tells of some terrible strain of work or of anxiety at that particular moment
rules.source_quote: When the line of head runs through a well-formed square, it is a sign of strength and preservation to the brain itself, and tells of some terrible strain of work or of anxiety at that particular moment.

rules.claim: An island heavily marked on the line of heart denotes heart-disease inherited
rules.source_quote: as, for instance, heavily marked on the line of heart it denotes heart-disease inherited.

rules.claim: When as one distinct mark in the center of the line of head, an island denotes an hereditary weakness in relation to mentality
rules.source_quote: When as one distinct mark in the center of the line of head, it denotes an hereditary weakness in relation to mentality.

rules.claim: When an island is on the line of life, it denotes illness and delicacy at that particular point
rules.source_quote: When on the line of life, it denotes illness and delicacy at that particular point.

rules.claim: When an island is on the line of fate, it denotes some heavy loss in worldly matters
rules.source_quote: When on the line of fate, some heavy loss in worldly matters.

rules.claim: When an island is on the line of sun, it foretells loss of position and name, generally through scandal
rules.source_quote: When on the line of sun, it foretells loss of position and name, generally through scandal (h, Plate XX1).

rules.claim: When an island is on the line of health, it foreshadows a serious illness
rules.source_quote: When on the line of health, it foreshadows a serious illness.

rules.claim: On the Mount of Jupiter the grille denotes egotism, pride, and the dominative spirit
rules.source_quote: On the Mount of Jupiter it denotes egotism, pride, and the dominative spirit.

rules.claim: On the Mount of Saturn the grille foretells misfortune, a melancholy nature, and a morbid tendency
rules.source_quote: On the Mount of Saturn it foretells misfortune, a melancholy nature, and a morbid tendency.

rules.claim: On the Mount of the Sun the grille tells of vanity, folly, and a desire for celebrity
rules.source_quote: On the Mount of the Sun it tells of vanity, folly, and a desire for celebrity.

rules.claim: On the Mount of Mercury the grille denotes an unstable and rather unprincipled person
rules.source_quote: On the Mount of Mercury it denotes an unstable and rather unprincipled person.

rules.claim: On the Mount of Luna the grille foretells restlessness, discontent, and disquietude
rules.source_quote: On the Mount of Luna it foretells restlessness, discontent, and dis- qnietude.

rules.claim: On the Mount of Venus the grille denotes caprice in passion
rules.source_quote: On the Mount of Venus, caprice 11 passion.

rules.claim: When distinct in shape on the Mount of Jupiter, the triangle promises more than usual success in the management of people and in the organization of every-day affairs
rules.source_quote: When distinct in shape on the Mount of Jupiter, it promises more than usual success in the management of people, in the handling of men, and even in the organization of every-day affairs.

rules.claim: On the Mount of Saturn the triangle gives a talent and inclination for mystical work, for the delving into the occult, and for the study of human magnetism
rules.source_quote: On the Mount of Saturn it gives a talent and inclination for mystical work, for the delving into the occult, for the study of human magnetism, and so forth.

rules.claim: When the entire hand is covered with a multitude of fine lines like a net and the palm is soft, such people imagine all sorts of things in the way of ailments and troubles
rules.source_quote: This is particularly so if the pahn be soft—such people imagine all sorts of things 1 the way of ailments and troubles;

rules.claim: Very smooth hands with few lines and a firm palm belong to people calm in temperament and even in disposition; a greater sign of control and calmness than when soft
rules.source_quote: Very smooth hands with few lines belong to people calm in temperament and even in disposition.

rules.claim: When the palm of the hand is covered naturally with a very fine light skin, the subject will retain the buoyancy and temperament of youth much longer than the person with a coarse skin
rules.source_quote: When the palm of the hand is covered naturally with a very fine ight skin, the subject will retain the buoyancy and temperament of youth much longer than the person with a coarse skin.

rules.claim: When the quadrangle is much wider under the Mount of the Sun than Saturn, the person is careless about his name, position, or reputation
rules.source_quote: When much wider under the Mount of the Sun than Saturn, the person is careless about his name, position, or repu- tation.

rules.claim: When the quadrangle is narrow under the Mount of the Sun, it is a sign of intense anxiety as to the opinion of other people—what the world thinks and what one must do to keep up reputation
rules.source_quote: It is in such a case a sign of intense anxiety as to the opinion of other people— what the world thinks, and what one must do to keep up one’s reputation.
